summary.headline: KCC E&C wins KRW 143.6bn contract for Bucheon NH logistics center construction
summary.what_happened: KCC ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. disclosed on Nov 27, 2026 that it signed a construction contract, dated Nov 26, 2026, for the new construction of the Bucheon NH Logistics Center in Samjeong-dong, Bucheon-si, Gyeonggi-do. The counterparty is NH Amundi Logistics Real Estate Private Placement Investment Company No. 1, and the contract runs from Dec 21, 2026 to Jun 21, 2029.
summary.why_it_matters: Large construction supply contracts of this kind are typically disclosed so shareholders can gauge the size of a company's new order backlog relative to its revenue. Such contracts are generally paid as work progresses and their amounts can change under the terms of the construction agreement.
